summary: Iteration 43 end-to-end verification of the new Admin CRUD surface (users + unified content). All 17 pytest backend cases pass and every frontend acceptance criterion in the request passes. UsersTab renders on deep-link /admin?tab=users, search + role filter work, edit dialog opens with all 5 fields, Save mutates the row and closes with a success toast. ContentTab renders on deep-link /admin?tab=content with all 5 type pills, rentals pill switches data, edit dialog opens per-type, bulk-select-all reveals the Delete N button, and regression /admin?tab=affiliates still routes correctly.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' on both admin-user-edit-dialog and admin-content-edit-dialog. Not blocking, but adds an a11y warning to the console. Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add <DialogDescription> to UsersTab.UserEditDialog and ContentTab.ContentEditDialog to remove the Radix Dialog aria-describedby console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_crud.py: PATCH /admin/users allows changing `email` without uniqueness / format validation — a rogue admin (or a bug in the UI) could set two users to the same email and quietly break login. Consider adding a uniqueness check + basic email regex.

admin_crud.py PATCH /admin/users: `body.model_dump()` drops `None` fields via the `is not None` filter, which correctly means 'field omitted stays unchanged'. Fine — but note that this also means the admin cannot explicitly clear a user's name back to null (would have to set empty string, which passes the filter). Non-blocking.

UsersTab.jsx save(): sends `email: form.email || null` and `role: form.role || null`. The backend filters out None, so these are safe, but the coupling is subtle — a maintainer changing the backend to accept None would break the UI. Consider only including fields whose value actually changed.

ContentTab.jsx: numeric coercion set is hard-coded (['price','price_per_night','budget','mileage','year']). If a new type adds numeric fields in admin_crud.CONTENT_TYPES, this list has to be updated in two places. Consider fetching an `editable_types` map that includes field-type metadata from /admin/content/types.
admin_crud.delete_content silently 404s on missing IDs but bulk-delete just reports deleted_count with no signal that some IDs were skipped. Consider returning `not_found: [...]` for UX transparency.

AdminConsole.jsx: `tab` state is kept in useState + synced to URL via useEffect. When the tab is deep-linked and the URL parameter changes externally (e.g., back button), state does NOT re-sync back — the URL wins on initial mount only. Not blocking for this iteration but worth noting.
test_credentials: admin@lumo.test / password123 and customer@lumo.test / password123 (both from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates throwaway users (email prefixed test_admin_crud_delete_*) and listings (title prefixed ADMIN_CRUD_TEST_*), all deleted before test exit. One UI-test rename during frontend E2E was reverted post-hoc via /api/admin/users PATCH.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin CRUD is verified end-to-end. If future iterations add new content types to admin_crud.CONTENT_TYPES, extend the parametrize list in test_iter43_admin_crud.TestListContent and the numeric-coercion set in ContentTab.jsx. To authenticate in the browser test, ALWAYS set localStorage.lumo_token BEFORE navigating to /admin?tab=<x> — navigating first triggers <Navigate to='/login'/> which strips the query params.
